function: Neural scene reconstruction (occupancy-map classification) from backscattered downlink signals (p. 1); precoder, waveform and resources are standard and not learned (pp. 5-6).
notes: Excluded for function (reviewer to confirm). The only learned element is a ResNet-style CNN that maps features of the estimated sensing channel to discrete occupancy maps (p. 1 abstract; p. 10, Section IV-D). The communication link is a standard MIMO-OFDM downlink with zero-forcing precoding, and p. 6 (Remark 6) states "there are no learnable parameters in the communication link", so no beams, waveforms or resources are learned (area 5). Sensing channel estimation is non-learned Tikhonov-regularized least squares (p. 9), so it is not area 2. Borderline: the system is an ISAC downlink that also serves UEs (p. 3), so a reviewer who counts learned sensing inside an ISAC system as area 5 would include it.
